speaker: silas
text: Go on, little loaf. Drag one barley sheaf onto the other and they'll join into flour, Esther's way.

speaker: silas
text: Tap Grandma's Pantry on the bottom row to bring out more. Free for now, mind you, same as my advice.

speaker: silas
text: I'd take a flatbread, warm. Keep joining matching things till you have one, then tap Deliver on my card.

speaker: naomi
text: Hm, a Blessing for one flatbread. Tap Go at the top to spend it and clear the bakehouse doorway.

speaker: naomi
text: That glowing fruit from the Tree of Life is Love. My own card wants it, of all things, so tap Deliver.

speaker: silas
text: On your own now, little loaf. Fill orders for Blessings; spend them to mend the bakehouse and unfold the story.
